## Description

Feature flags stored per tenant (flag key, enabled, owner, created/changed by, audit). Evaluated server-side and exposed in /v1/me/context; UI hides routes and nav items for disabled flags; API rejects calls to disabled features with 404. Flags can be turned off without redeploy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Turning a flag off hides the feature for that tenant within one minute without redeploy.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every flag has an owner and description; flag changes are audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** API endpoints behind a disabled flag return 404 (not 403) and are not listed in the tenant's navigation.
- [ ] **AC4.** Flags default to off for new features.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
